source_reconstruction.objects: Euclidean position/momentum x,p in R^d; fixed y and reference xtilde; eta>0; gradient residual h(x)=grad V(x)-grad V(xtilde); center c=y-eta grad V(xtilde).
source_reconstruction.bounce: S(x,p)=(x,R_h(x)p), R_h=I-2hh^T/||h||^2 for h nonzero and R_0=I. S is Borel, involutive; no continuity at zero is asserted.
source_reconstruction.reversal: R(x,p)=(x,-p); R Phi_t R=Phi_-t and RS=SR. S involution plus commutation implies (RS)^2=id.
source_reconstruction.rate: lambda(x,p)=sqrt(eta) max(p dot h(x),0). lambda(RS z)=lambda(z), including zero normal; A5 states the identity at actual nontrivial jumps, with its positivity restrictions unnecessary for the algebraic identity.
source_reconstruction.measure: mu=Lebesgue_x product Lebesgue_p, including the unique rank-zero state if formal carrier permits rank zero. Phi_t,R,S preserve mu, and are Borel bijections. Flow uses reciprocal scalings; S uses measurable dependence on x and orthogonal p fibers.
source_reconstruction.integral: A6: integral F(S z) dmu=integral F(z) dmu for every integrable F; real-valued F is a faithful bounded interface.
source_reconstruction.endpoint: For fixed finite ordered jump times, endpoint and R composed endpoint are finite compositions of the maps above, hence Borel measure-preserving bijections. Reversal elementary identities support the inverse endpoint construction.
source_reconstruction.scope: No path reversal equality at jump values, no clock/simplex product change of variables, no A4 density-survival identity, no A7 path expansion, no A3 adjoint identity, invariance, L2 semigroup or main theorem completion.

source_regions.coverage: actual flow, residual reflection, zero convention
flow/reversal/bounce product-volume preservation and integral identity
finite endpoint composition and inverse mechanics only

excluded: A8 path equality at jump values
